What is a MonetizationOS?

Many companies bury pricing logic inside billing systems or product code, making every change slow, brittle, and risky.

A MonetizationOS like Stigg centralizes pricing, packaging, entitlements, and usage into one programmable system of record. This lets you run experiments, launch new SKUs, and monetize AI features without touching fragile billing code.

Modern monetization infrastructure  starts with Entitlements

What are Entitlements?

Entitlements define the value your customers receive; the features, limits, usage, and credits in every plan. They are the foundation of modern monetization.  

When this logic is hardcoded into product or billing systems, every change is slow, fragile, and risky.  

With Stigg, entitlements become a flexible, programmable system of record. You can define, update, and experiment with packaging instantly, while Stigg keeps product, billing, CRM, CPQ, and data warehouses in sync automatically.

Built for speed & scale with an always-on architechture

Highly Available
Core API services are deployed across multiple regions to ensure high availability with automated failover. Asynchronous data replication across regions achieves redundancy and low latency, with an uptime SLA of 99.99%.
Low-latency caching layer
Stigg offers a local cache to minimize network dependency and support offline operations. An external persistent store option enhances data durability across restarts and reduces cache misses in large or transient environments.
Delivered over the Edge Network
Edge API leverages a CDN with over 300 global PoPs for scalability and high availability. It executes code at the nearest regional edge to minimize latency and efficiently manages large volumes of concurrent requests with its auto-scaling FaaS architecture.
Metering at scale
Metering API handles high-volume, real-time events, processing thousands per second from a single source. Built-in idempotency prevents duplicates, and aggregated data are distributed across regions to minimize network latency.
Fault tolerant
Stigg is built on a reliable integration architecture that utilizes durable queues, webhook notifications, and retries for errors, along with alerts for failures. API calls are audited, logged, and monitored for effective data reconciliation.
